* Understanding of website structure, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, schema markup, and indexing.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret SEO performance data.
* Good communication, problem-solving, and reporting skills.

Preferred Qualifications

What We Offer

title: Social Media & Creator Executive
description:
Brillare International · United States launch

**Brand**

Brillare, Emami’s plant-based professional haircare brand

**Market**

United States first; the United Kingdom may follow

The role

Run the creator programme that launches Brillare in the United States, and the social channels it feeds. Build Brillare's Internaltional Instagram and Facebook from zero and run the creator program that feeds it with video. Brillare is an Emami haircare brand launching in the US on Amazon and Shopify.

What success looks like

**By when**

**What good looks like**

**First 30 days**

A shortlist of 150 US creators across hair types; brief, contract and usage-rights templates in place; the claims checklist signed off; Instagram and TikTok accounts live.

**First 90 days**

40 or more creators active, 60 or more usable videos delivered, and at least 10 of them running in paid ads.

**Every month**

Usable videos delivered, cost per usable video, the share of videos that go on to run in ads, on-time delivery, and zero claims or disclosure breaches.

What you will doCreators (50%)

* Build a bench of US haircare creators, mostly nano and micro (1,000 to 100,000 followers), across straight, wavy, curly and coily hair and across thinning, shedding and scalp concerns.
* Run the full cycle yourself: shortlist, negotiate (gifted, flat fee or affiliate commission), brief, ship product, chase delivery and arrange payment.
* Secure written usage rights for every video, for a stated term, covering paid ads (including partnership and Spark Ads), Amazon listings and Brand Store, and our website.
* Bring the best creators into the TikTok Shop affiliate programme and Amazon’s creator programmes, so their videos earn commission on sales rather than a flat fee.
* Keep one creator tracker: rates, deliverables, results and usage-rights expiry dates.

Social (35%)

* Launch and run Brillare US on Instagram and TikTok: 4 to 5 feed posts, 3 to 5 Reels or TikToks and daily Stories each week. Facebook runs as the page behind our ads and for community replies.
* Edit creator footage into Reels, TikToks and ad cut-downs yourself: hooks, captions, 9:16 and multiple lengths.
* Answer comments and DMs within one US business day. Pass any product complaint or skin or scalp reaction to customer service the same day.

Learning loop (15%)

* Send a weekly one-page report: videos delivered, cost per usable video, which videos the ads team scaled, and what to brief next.
* Pass the strongest videos to the performance marketing team, and the recurring questions and complaints from comments to the product and Amazon teams.

Rules that are not negotiable

* **Claims.** Use only our approved claims list, which describes how hair looks and how the scalp feels. Never say stops hair loss or treats dandruff.
* **Approval.** Check every creator script and video before it goes live, and keep a record of what you approved.
* **Disclosure.** Every paid, gifted or affiliate post is clearly labelled as the FTC requires: #ad or the platform’s paid-partnership label at the start of the caption, and said or shown in the video itself.
* **Reviews.** Never offer creators or customers payment, free product or any reward for an Amazon review or rating. Amazon bans it and the FTC fines it.
* **Age.** Work only with creators aged 18 or over.

What you bringMust have

* At least 50 creators managed end to end in the last two years, with briefs you wrote and the videos you got back.
* Written English that US creators reply to: clear, warm and fast.
* Comfort with numbers: you track cost per video and which videos earn their keep, not just likes.
* Willingness to work the US overlap hours at times

**Nice to have:** a US beauty or haircare launch, TikTok Shop affiliate experience, creator tools (Aspire, GRIN, Captiv8), basic Meta Ads and Spark Adsve

* Ensure proper implementation of meta tags, header tags, schema markup, alt text, and internal linking.
* Collaborate with content writers to create helpful, people-first content aligned with Google's E-E-A-T guidelines (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness).
* Build topical authority through pillar pages, topic clusters, and entity-based content planning.
* Improve site structure, crawlability, and user experience to enhance rankings.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), site speed, and mobile-first performance.
* Regularly refresh and update existing content to prevent ranking decay.

2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / AI Search Visibility

* Develop strategies to improve brand visibility and citations in AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot.
* Structure content for AI extraction: clear answers, FAQs, comparison tables, statistics, and well-organized passages.
* Strengthen entity signals (brand, services, people, and locations) through schema, Knowledge Panel optimization, and consistent brand information across the web.
* Track brand mentions, citations, and share of voice across AI platforms using appropriate tools.
* Manage AI crawler access (robots.txt for GPTBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, etc.) and evaluate emerging standards such as llms.txt.
* Optimize for Bing (Bing Webmaster Tools, IndexNow), as it powers several AI search experiences.

3. Off-Page Optimization and Digital PR

* Develop and execute quality link-building strategies, including guest posts, outreach, digital PR, and data-led content.
* Build relationships with relevant websites, industry publications, journalists, and influencers.
* Drive unlinked brand mentions and listings on review and directory platforms (Clutch, GoodFirms, G2, etc.), which influence both SEO and AI recommendations.
* Manage link profile health and perform backlink audits to identify and handle toxic or spammy links.
* Monitor competitors' backlink and PR strategies and identify new opportunities.
* Ensure all link-building complies with Google's spam policies.

* Work with the development team to fix crawling, indexing, rendering, and other technical issues.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and hreflang for multi-region sites.
* Audit JavaScript rendering and indexing for modern frameworks (React, Next.js, etc.).
* Implement and validate structured data (Organization, Service, FAQ, Article, Breadcrumb, Review, etc.).
* Conduct log file analysis and crawl budget optimization where needed.
* Optimize website architecture for better indexing and ranking performance.

* Identify and resolve keyword cannibalisation, thin content, duplicate content, weak internal linking and underperforming high\-potential pages.
* Build strategies around user intent and conversion potential rather than rankings alone.

**3\. AI Search \& Generative Discovery**

Search is expanding beyond traditional Google results. You should understand how visibility is evolving across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and other AI\-powered search and answer platforms.

* Develop strategies for Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and AI Search visibility.

* Identify opportunities for Ebizfiling to become a trusted source that search engines and AI systems can surface, reference and recommend.
* Track and test changes in AI\-driven discovery and adapt the organic strategy accordingly.

**4\. Lead Generation \& Conversion**

SEO at Ebizfiling is treated as a customer\-acquisition channel, not a traffic\-only function.

**THE FUNNEL**

Search → Landing Page → Engagement → Enquiry → Qualified Lead → Customer

* Identify high\-traffic pages that fail to generate enquiries or qualified leads.
* Improve conversion paths, calls to action and service\-page journeys.
* Identify high\-intent queries with weak commercial outcomes and diagnose why.
* Convert relevant informational traffic into commercial opportunities without compromising content usefulness.
* Measure lead quality and business contribution, not just traffic volume.

**5\. Content, Authority \& Accuracy**

* Lead search\-intent mapping, content\-gap analysis, topic clustering, content briefs and content upgrades.
* Improve internal linking, FAQs, structured answers and content consolidation.
* Regularly identify outdated pages affected by changes in laws, government forms, filing requirements, due dates, fees, tax provisions, thresholds or compliance procedures.
* Prefer improving valuable existing assets over publishing large volumes of low\-value content.
* Work with subject\-matter and internal teams to ensure content remains accurate, useful and commercially relevant.

**6\. AI\-Assisted SEO**

* Use AI tools for research, search\-intent analysis, competitor intelligence, content\-gap discovery, topic clustering, briefs, FAQs, internal\-linking opportunities, data analysis and experimentation.
* Build efficient AI\-assisted workflows without compromising accuracy, originality or subject expertise.

* Avoid mass\-generated commodity content that adds little value to users or the brand.

**8\. Analytics \& Competitive Intelligence**

* PageSpeed Insights and Google Trends

* ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity or comparable AI platforms

Knowing the tools is expected. Knowing what decisions to make from the data is what matters.
